_doc: Role of the Dystopia ingestion agent (Agente de ingesta). WRITES only in the deception-* indices (data streams deception-events and deception-alerts) and can create them. NO Kibana, NO read privileges other than the ones below, NO destructive ops.

dystopia.note: manage_index_templates only affects deception-*/deception-alerts* by name; if generating broader templates, restore to monitor
